# Kairos v2.0.4 Performance Release

**Optional upgrade · No consensus changes**

This release focuses on reducing node resource usage and retiring obsolete proof machinery while preserving independent verification from genesis.

### P2P performance

* 72% lower average CPU usage under comparable mainnet peer load
* 1.66× faster HistoryStep verification under live peer load
* About 98% less CPU use in the local retained object serving benchmark
* Bounded digest cache for 64 objects with concurrent request coalescing
* Full native verification remains in place for incoming objects, blocks and proofs
* 215 P2P tests passed

### Legacy proof retirement

* Old HistoryStep matrices removed from release binaries and input archives
* History before v2 verified through retirement certificates under independently pinned keys
* Retirement proof included in the node binary for synchronization through existing v2.0.3 peers
* Smaller node binaries across all platforms by removing the old matrices
* Mainnet cold sync and restart passed on four CPUs with an 8 GiB memory limit

### Security review

October attack review updated. The v2 soundness certificate was reproduced unchanged, retaining its NIST PQC Category 1 assessment under the published certificate conditions.

### Updating

Install and start normally. Existing databases, wallet keys, receipts and contract evidence are preserved. Nodes running v2.0.3 remain compatible.
